instruction: Create the package lib/wordcount with the module lib/wordcount/counter.py. It needs a function count_words(text) that returns how many words the text has: words are separated by any whitespace, and an empty or blank text has 0. Make sure counter.py handles tabs and newlines. Then add test_counter.py next to the existing tests, and make `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` pass.
